subject: general
question: Who among the following was one of the recipients of the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **Neeraj Chopra**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award is presented by the** Indian government and the Department of Sport** to those sportspersons who have excelled in their sports over a period of** four years.**
 
• Neeraj Chopra is the** first Asian athlete to win an Olympic gold medal in Men's Javelin throw,** is among the** 12 sportspersons** named for the **country's highest sporting** **award** - the Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award.
 
• List of** sportspersons **to win the award are:
 
 
• Neeraj Chopra (Athletics)__, **Ravi Kumar (Wrestling), Lovlina Borgohain (Boxing), Sreejesh P.R (Hockey), Avani Lekhara (Para Shooting), Sumit Antil (Para-Athletics), Pramod Bhagat (Para Badminton), Krishna Nagar (Para Badminton), Manish Narwal (Para Shooting), Mithali Raj (Cricket), Sunil Chhetri (Football), and Manpreet Singh (Hockey).**
 
 
 
• Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award was** previously known as Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• ** Mary Kom** is the **first Indian female boxer to win a gold medal in the Asian Games in 2014 **at Incheon, South Korea and is the **first Indian female boxer to win gold at the 2018 Commonwealth Games.**
 
• **Mary Kom is also the only boxer to become Asian Amateur Boxing Champion for a record six times.**
 
• **Jwala Gutta is an Indian badminton player**. She has a total of 316 match wins in both the disciplines—the most by any Indian—and peaked at no. 6 in the world rankings.
 
• **Virat Kohli is an Indian international cricketer and former captain of the Indian national team.**
